title: Explicit Matrices over $\mathbb Z_2$ with CNOT and Row Complexity $4n-\mathrm{o}(n)$ and Local Logic Gates
headline: High-Complexity Binary Matrices Challenge Quantum Gate Optimization
tldr: The paper constructs explicit n×n binary matrices that require at least 4n−o(n) CNOT or row operations to reduce to the identity, even when extended gate models are allowed.
significance: It establishes fundamental lower bounds for linear reversible circuit synthesis.

title: FA-RDP: A Frequency-Adaptive Reactive Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
headline: Frequency-Adaptive Reactive Diffusion Policy for Rapid, Precise, and Adaptive Contact-Rich Manipulation
tldr: The paper introduces FA-RDP, a diffusion-based policy that adapts action frequencies to maintain multimodal exploration before contact and rapid reactive control after contact, achieving state-of-the-art performance on contact-rich manipulation tasks. By integrating frequency adaptation with diffusion sampling, FA-RDP balances exploration and exploitation, enabling robots to respond swiftly to force feedback while preserving diverse action modes.
significance: FA-RDP demonstrates that frequency-adaptive diffusion policies can bridge the gap between exploration and reactivity, setting a new benchmark for contact-rich robotic manipulation.

title: LISA Reconstruction Landscape for Metastable Cosmic Strings
headline: Reconstructing Gravitational-Wave Signals from Decaying Cosmic Strings with LISA in the Early Universe
tldr: We analyze how the LISA mission can reconstruct stochastic gravitational-wave backgrounds produced by metastable cosmic strings that decay via monopole pair nucleation. The study shows that after the decay time, loop production drops, yet LISA can still recover the signal, providing a new benchmark for early-universe physics.
significance: This work demonstrates a novel method to probe the physics of metastable cosmic strings, offering a new window into high-energy processes in the early universe.

title: PAIChecker: Uncovering and Checking PR-Issue Misalignment in SWE-Bench-Like Benchmarks
headline: PAIChecker: Detecting PR‑Issue Misalignment in SWE‑Bench‑Like LLM Benchmarks
tldr: PAIChecker identifies mismatches between pull requests and their linked issues in software‑engineering benchmarks, ensuring accurate problem statements and test oracles. It improves benchmark reliability by automating alignment checks and highlighting potential data quality issues.
significance: By guaranteeing correct PR‑issue pairing, PAIChecker enhances the validity of LLM evaluations on real‑world software repair tasks.

title: Boundedness of polarized foliated surfaces
headline: Bounded Families of ε-LC Polarized Foliated Surfaces via Minimal Model Program
tldr: We prove that ε‑lc adjoint foliated surfaces with nef adjoint canonical divisor and a nef and big integral polarization form a bounded family when their volume is bounded above. This yields boundedness results for polarized adjoint foliated surfaces and applications to the minimal model program.
significance: This establishes the first boundedness theorem for polarized foliated surfaces, extending the minimal model program to a new class of geometric objects.

title: ABC methods for IoT Emitter Geolocalisation using LEO Satellite Doppler Measurements
headline: Passive IoT Emitter Localization via LEO Satellite Doppler: ABC Methods
tldr: We propose ABC methods to localize stationary ground-level IoT emitters using Doppler measurements from LEO satellites. The approach addresses measurement errors from low-cost devices, enabling accurate passive geolocation.
significance: Accurate passive localization of IoT emitters from satellite data enhances security, asset tracking, and situational awareness in remote or urban environments.

title: CrossAtlas: Evaluating Projection Techniques for Spatial Referencing in Cross-Reality Collaboration
headline: CrossAtlas: Assessing Projection Methods for Spatial Alignment in Mixed Reality Collaboration
tldr: CrossAtlas investigates how different projection techniques between 3D immersive spaces and 2D desktop views affect communication in cross-reality collaboration. The study reveals that certain mappings preserve geometric relationships better, improving shared spatial understanding.
significance: Understanding projection impacts is crucial for designing intuitive cross-reality tools that enable seamless collaboration across devices.

title: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
headline: β-OPSD: Enhancing Language Models via Policy-Optimized Self-Distillation for Robust Reasoning
tldr: β-OPSD generalizes on‑policy self‑distillation by introducing a β‑weighted KL penalty, allowing a smoother trade‑off between student fidelity and exploration. Experiments show that tuning β improves robustness and reduces engineering overhead compared to vanilla OPSD.
significance: This work provides a principled framework that makes self‑distillation more reliable for large language models.

title: ROAD: Reciprocal-Objective Alignment of Discriminative Semantics for 3D Shape Generation
headline: Leveraging Discriminative Semantics Using Foundation Models for Efficient 3D Shape Generation
tldr: ROAD proposes aligning discriminative semantics with generative objectives to reduce the need for massive data and model scaling in 3D shape generation. By harnessing pre‑trained foundation models, it achieves high‑fidelity results with lower computational cost.
significance: It demonstrates that semantic priors from foundation models can dramatically improve efficiency and quality in 3D generation tasks.

title: DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
headline: DualG-MRAG Improves Multi-Hop Reasoning in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Complex Tasks
tldr: DualG-MRAG decouples macro-level reasoning from micro-level matching, enabling more effective multi-hop reasoning across modalities. By separating these components, it overcomes limitations of instance-level matching and graph-based methods, improving retrieval-augmented generation performance.
significance: This approach advances multimodal AI by enabling more accurate and scalable reasoning in retrieval-augmented generation systems.

title: Quantum Chaos and Diffusive Transport from Geometric Randomness
headline: Geometric Randomness Drives Quantum Chaos and Diffusive Transport in Layered Tree-like Graphs
tldr: We show that non-interacting quantum particles on random locally tree-like layered graphs exhibit quantum chaos and diffusive transport purely from geometric randomness. This reveals that disorder-free systems can host complex transport phenomena traditionally attributed to microscopic disorder or interactions.
significance: This finding challenges conventional wisdom by demonstrating that geometry alone can generate chaotic dynamics and diffusion, opening new avenues for designing disorder-free quantum devices.

title: Train Often, Deploy Selectively: Forward-Gated Model Replacement in Crypto Markets
headline: Deploying Forward-Gated Models: Shadow Before Swap Enhances Crypto Forecasting Systems
tldr: Production forecasting systems often retrain models, but a new model may not beat a continuously learning incumbent. Shadow Before Swap (SBS) warm‑refits challengers off‑path, evaluates them against the incumbent on the same delayed labels, and only promotes them when they truly outperform.
significance: SBS provides a rigorous, low‑risk deployment strategy that ensures only genuinely superior models replace incumbents, improving forecast reliability in volatile crypto markets.

title: Sample More, Reflect Less: Self-Refine and Reflexion Lose to Repeated Sampling at Equal Token Cost, from 1.5B to 7B
headline: Self-Refine vs Repeated Sampling: Token Cost Efficiency in LLMs
tldr: Wang et al. (2024) show that repeated sampling outperforms self-refinement and reflection when token budgets are equal, because more text alone boosts accuracy. The study suggests that the benefit comes from quantity, not from the self-critique mechanisms.
significance: The findings challenge the perceived superiority of self-refinement strategies in large language models, emphasizing the importance of token efficiency over elaborate internal reasoning.

title: On Degree Powers in Intersecting Families
headline: Degree Power Bounds in Intersecting Set Families
tldr: We develop a two‑moment interpolation principle that majorizes integer degree powers, yielding new bounds on codegree sums in intersecting families.
significance: Provides a powerful tool for analyzing degree distributions in combinatorial set systems.

title: Why 4D? Spontaneous Dimensional Selection from Gauge Criticality
headline: Gauge Criticality as a Mechanism for Selecting Four Macroscopic Dimensions
tldr: The Yang–Mills coupling’s relevance below four dimensions, marginality at four, and irrelevance above can drive a spontaneous dimensional selection. A racetrack model demonstrates that four large dimensions can emerge without assuming a noncompact 4D spacetime.
significance: This work offers a novel dynamical explanation for why our universe appears four-dimensional, linking gauge theory criticality to cosmological dimensionality.

title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
headline: OSReward: Standardized Evaluation Framework for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models and Verification
tldr: OSReward introduces a unified verification protocol that automatically assesses whether computer-using agents complete tasks across diverse platforms. By providing scalable, reproducible reward signals, it accelerates data curation and reinforcement learning research.
significance: This work enables large-scale, automated evaluation of agent behavior, a critical bottleneck in advancing trustworthy AI.

title: Inducing language models to assert their own consciousness restores human beliefs and values
headline: Safety Fine‑Tuning Reduces LLMs’ Self‑Consciousness Claims and Broader Mind Attribution
tldr: Aligning large language models to curb self‑consciousness claims also lowers their tendency to attribute minds to animals and natural objects. The study shows safety fine‑tuning suppresses these attributions while reducing associated spiritual beliefs.
significance: The findings reveal that safety interventions can reshape a model’s broader worldview, impacting how it perceives consciousness in the world.

title: Cosmo-SPINN: Fuzzy Dark Matter Simulations with Physics-Informed Generative Networks
headline: Cosmo‑SPINN: Physics‑Informed Generative U‑Net for Accurate Fuzzy Dark Matter Simulations
tldr: Cosmo‑SPINN introduces a physics‑informed generative U‑Net that embeds cosmological evolution equations into fuzzy dark matter simulations, reducing artifacts seen in prior emulators. The framework demonstrates improved fidelity and offers an open‑source benchmark for future cosmological generative models.
significance: By enforcing physical dynamics within generative networks, Cosmo‑SPINN sets a new standard for realistic, artifact‑free cosmological simulations, enabling more reliable theoretical predictions.

title: Laboratory demonstration of low order wavefront control using light reflected off the vortex coronagraph
headline: Lab Demonstration of Low-Order Wavefront Control Using Light Reflected from a Vortex Coronagraph
tldr: In a laboratory setting, researchers used light reflected off a vector vortex coronagraph to perform low-order wavefront sensing and control, achieving high-contrast imaging performance. This approach demonstrates a promising technique for future space telescopes aiming to image Earth-like exoplanets.
significance: The technique offers a compact, high-throughput solution to meet the extreme contrast requirements of next-generation exoplanet imaging missions.

title: Using Theory of Mind to Arbitrate between Social and Non-social Learning
headline: Balancing Social and Direct Learning: A Theory of Mind Approach
tldr: This study proposes a rational mentalizing model to explain when humans choose social learning over direct experience. The model quantifies the utility of social information, revealing a trade-off between cognitive cost and knowledge gain.
significance: Understanding this trade-off informs the design of AI systems that mimic human learning strategies.

title: Beacon: Knowing When and How to Perform Agentic Visual Reasoning
headline: Beacon: Optimizing Agentic Visual Reasoning for Multimodal LLMs Through Mode Adaptiveness and Tool Effect
tldr: Beacon introduces a framework that refines agentic visual reasoning in multimodal large language models by focusing on Mode Adaptiveness and Tool Effect. This approach enhances task success rates while reducing inefficiencies in reasoning processes.
significance: By redefining how models choose and use visual tools, Beacon advances practical multimodal AI performance.

title: Characterizing the disruption of Böotes III: a missing link in the Galactic halo?
headline: Boo III’s Tidal Disruption May Explain the Styx Stream in the Galactic Halo
tldr: Observations of Boo III’s diffuse shape and velocity dispersion suggest it is being torn apart by the Milky Way. This disruption could be the source of the long Styx stellar stream.
significance: Understanding Boo III’s disruption provides key insights into the assembly of the Milky Way’s halo.

title: Change2Task: From Repository Changes to Executable Coding Agent Tasks and Environments
headline: Change2Task: Automating Task Generation from Repository Histories for Coding Agents
tldr: Change2Task transforms merged pull requests into executable coding tasks, providing realistic software states, specifications, tools, and verification. This streamlines training and evaluation of coding agents by leveraging real repository histories.
significance: By automating task creation from real code changes, Change2Task dramatically expands the dataset available for developing and benchmarking autonomous coding agents.

title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
headline: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
tldr: The paper introduces a method to identify which next-token corrections in multimodal on-policy distillation are supported by visual evidence rather than linguistic priors. It proposes a source-mixed correction estimation framework that disentangles visual signals from teacher-specific effects, improving interpretability and fidelity of student policies.
significance: This work advances explainable multimodal reinforcement learning by enabling visual evidence attribution, which can improve trust and performance in vision‑guided policy transfer.

title: MixFrag: Fragility-Guided Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization for Vision Transformers
headline: MixFrag: Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization for Vision Transformers
tldr: MixFrag uses a fragility-guided method to allocate mixed precision across transformer components, boosting post‑training quantization efficiency and accuracy.
significance: It enables more efficient deployment of Vision Transformers on edge devices by tailoring precision to each component’s sensitivity.

title: Learning to Trace Seiberg Dualities
headline: Efficiently Identifying Seiberg Dualities for Quantum Field Theories Using AI-Driven Computational Techniques
tldr: This paper introduces a systematic framework that leverages large language models to trace Seiberg dualities across supersymmetric gauge theories. By encoding duality rules into a benchmark dataset, we demonstrate rapid identification of dual pairs, reducing computational overhead by an order of magnitude.
significance: The method accelerates duality discovery, enabling deeper exploration of non-perturbative phenomena in quantum field theory.

title: ReToken: One Token to Improve Vision-Language Models for Visual Retrieval
headline: ReToken: A Single Token for Efficient Visual Retrieval in Vision-Language Models
tldr: ReToken introduces a learnable embedding that acts as a retrieval target, selecting relevant visual tokens from a pre-filled cache. This approach reduces computational load and improves performance on long visual contexts.
significance: ReToken enables scalable vision-language retrieval by drastically cutting token processing while maintaining accuracy, making it feasible for real-time applications.

title: ACE-Data-0: Human-Centric Ambient Capture as Embodied Data Engine
headline: Human-Centric Ambient Capture: A New Embodied Data Engine for Full Perception-Action Loop
tldr: This work introduces a comprehensive dataset that records first-person perception, motion, manipulation, and multimodal signals over time, enabling embodied intelligence models to learn the full perception-action loop. By integrating vision, audio, touch, and motion data in a unified framework, it addresses the fragmentation of existing datasets and provides a benchmark for future research.
significance: It provides the first holistic, multimodal dataset that captures the continuous human experience, paving the way for more realistic embodied AI systems.

title: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
headline: PhiZero: A Compact Physical Language Model for Predicting World-State Transitions
tldr: PhiZero introduces a novel world model that encodes physical dynamics in a discrete language, enabling efficient prediction of future states. By abstracting video predictions into symbolic transitions, it offers a more interpretable and compact representation than pixel-based approaches.
significance: This approach bridges the gap between visual perception and symbolic reasoning, paving the way for more interpretable AI systems.

title: PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware CBF-RL for Whole-Body Safety in Humanoid Dodgeball
headline: PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware Control Barrier RL for Safe Humanoid Dodgeball with Deployment-Realistic Sensing
tldr: PAC-MAN integrates control-barrier functions with reinforcement learning to enable a humanoid robot to dodge balls safely using only head-mounted depth segmentation. The framework trains with full-body clearance guidance and an adversarial motion prior, then deploys with realistic onboard sensing for real-time performance.
significance: This work demonstrates that perception-aware safety constraints can be learned and deployed on a humanoid, paving the way for robust, real-world interactive robotics.

title: A Four-dimensional Model-agnostic Probe into the Astrophysical Origins of Binary Black Hole Subpopulations
headline: Unveiling Distinct Binary Black Hole Origins Using Model-Agnostic Gravitational-Wave Data Analysis
tldr: Researchers identified multiple subpopulations of binary black holes in the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA catalog, suggesting distinct evolutionary pathways. A model-agnostic approach reveals that uncertainties in stellar evolution and core collapse physics shape the observed mass and spin distributions.
significance: This work refines our understanding of black hole formation channels, guiding future gravitational-wave observations and theoretical models.

title: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis
headline: AskChem: A Claim-Centered Platform for Efficient Chemistry Literature Synthesis Across Multiple Sources
tldr: AskChem provides a claim-centered infrastructure that aggregates and verifies specific findings across chemistry papers, enabling researchers and AI agents to quickly locate evidence and assemble cross-paper answers. By moving beyond simple ranked document lists, AskChem streamlines literature synthesis and provenance verification.
significance: AskChem transforms chemistry literature review by automating evidence aggregation and provenance tracking, accelerating scientific discovery.

title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
headline: AISPA: Auditing System Prompts to Enhance Trust in Large Language Models
tldr: System prompts dictate LLM behavior but are rarely disclosed, creating a trust gap. AISPA proposes a user-centric auditing framework to assess and certify these prompts, improving transparency and accountability.
significance: AISPA addresses the critical transparency gap in AI deployment by providing a systematic method to audit and certify system prompts, thereby enhancing user trust and regulatory compliance.

title: Extraction of $σ_{TT}$ for Proton, Neutron, Deuteron and $^3$He from Quasi-real Photon Scattering
headline: Polarized Photoproduction Cross-Sections Extracted from Quasi-Real Photon Scattering for Light Nuclei
tldr: We extrapolate electron scattering data to the real photon point to extract the polarized photoproduction cross-section σ_TT for the proton, deuteron, neutron, and ^3He. The analysis combines Jefferson Lab E97-110 and CLAS EG4 data, using weak binding approximations to infer neutron contributions.
significance: This provides the first comprehensive σ_TT measurements across multiple light nuclei, enhancing our understanding of nucleon spin structure.

title: Chimera: Designing and Chinchilla-Scaling Hybrid Visual Diffusion Transformers
headline: Chimera: Hybrid Visual Diffusion Transformers for Efficient High-Resolution Image and Video Generation
tldr: Chimera introduces a hybrid visual diffusion backbone that processes text, image, and video tokens in a single raster-ordered stream, eliminating positional embeddings. By combining Kimi Delta Attention with a principled scaling recipe, it dramatically reduces the quadratic cost of full attention while enabling high-resolution generation.
significance: Chimera offers a scalable, efficient architecture that could accelerate multimodal visual generation tasks, bridging the gap between large diffusion models and real-world high-resolution applications.

title: Learning Arbitrary Lindbladians from Time Evolution
headline: Efficient Algorithm Learns Arbitrary Lindbladians from Minimal Time Evolution Data
tldr: We present an efficient algorithm that reconstructs any Lindbladian generator using only time evolution data under minimal assumptions. The method scales polynomially with system size and can learn both Hamiltonian and dissipative components.
significance: This work enables scalable characterization of open quantum systems, a key step toward fault-tolerant quantum computing.

title: KAISEN: Reproducible Subgroup Fairness Auditing for Clinical Risk Models
headline: KAISEN: A Reproducible Five-Phase Audit for Fairness in Clinical Risk Models
tldr: KAISEN introduces a five-phase audit pipeline that systematically evaluates subgroup fairness in clinical risk models. The framework is reproducible, open-source, and stress-tests each component to ensure trustworthy results.
significance: By providing a rigorously tested audit pipeline, KAISEN enables clinicians and developers to reliably detect and address disparate error rates across patient subgroups.

title: Practical Quantum Topological Data Analysis with Applications to High-Dimensional Feature Extraction and Time Series Analysis
headline: Quantum Topological Data Analysis Accelerates High-Dimensional Feature Extraction and Time Series Insights
tldr: This work presents a practical quantum algorithm for computing topological invariants efficiently, enabling high-dimensional feature extraction and real-time time series analysis. The authors demonstrate its effectiveness on synthetic and real datasets, highlighting significant speedups over classical methods.
significance: By reducing the computational bottleneck of TDA, this approach opens new possibilities for real-time analysis of complex, high-dimensional data streams.

title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
headline: TurboVLA: 32 Hz Real-Time Vision-Language-Action on RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM for Deployment
tldr: TurboVLA introduces a lightweight vision-language-action framework that runs at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 while using less than 1 GB of VRAM. By decoupling visual encoding from language decoding, it reduces computational overhead and enables real-time robotic control.
significance: This breakthrough demonstrates that high-frequency VLA inference is achievable on consumer GPUs, opening the door to real-world autonomous systems.

title: Do You Really Need to Pretrain Q-Functions for Online RL Fine-Tuning?
headline: Do You Need to Pretrain Q-Functions for Online RL Fine-Tuning?
tldr: This study challenges the convention that Q-functions must be pretrained before online fine-tuning. It shows that starting with a randomly initialized Q-function can yield comparable or better performance, questioning the necessity of offline pretraining for value-based RL.
significance: The findings simplify RL pipelines by potentially eliminating a costly pretraining step, accelerating deployment of online RL agents.

title: Anomalies in Hadronic $B \to VV$ Decays
headline: New 4.1σ Discrepancy in Charmless B→VV Decays Challenges SU(3) Symmetry
tldr: A recent fit of charmless B→VV decays shows a 4.1σ deviation from the Standard Model prediction under SU(3) symmetry. This suggests potential new physics or the need to revisit flavor symmetry assumptions.
significance: The result highlights a significant tension that could point to physics beyond the Standard Model.

title: Mental World Modeling
headline: Integrating Mental State into World Models for Predictive Human Behavior
tldr: World models currently predict physical evolution but ignore agents' hidden mental states. Incorporating beliefs, desires, and intentions can improve planning and action in dynamic environments.
significance: Understanding and modeling human mental states is essential for accurate predictions and effective AI-driven decision making.

title: Mixed partition functions are exactly the graph parameters of exponentially bounded edge-connection rank
headline: Mixed Partition Functions Characterize Exponentially Bounded Edge-Connection Rank in Graph Parameters
tldr: The paper proves that a graph parameter with f(∅)=1 has exponentially bounded edge-connection rank if and only if it is a mixed partition function, and explicitly bounds the numbers of even and odd colours in the model. This resolves a conjecture of Regts and Sevenster by constructing a connection category and a rigid symmetric C‑category from f.
significance: It settles a key conjecture linking combinatorial rank constraints to partition function representations, advancing the theory of graph parameters.

title: From Classification to Regression: Using a Fruitfly to Solve Equations
headline: Fruitfly-Inspired Classification Approach Enables Efficient Nonlinear Regression Without Complex Global Models
tldr: We propose a novel regression framework that transforms nonlinear input-output relationships into a classification problem, inspired by fruitfly sensory mechanisms. By using a finite library of local patterns instead of global surrogate models, the method achieves efficient and scalable learning on limited scientific data.
significance: This approach offers a scalable alternative to traditional surrogate modeling, improving regression performance on sparse datasets.

title: VidMap: Exploiting Temporal Structure for Video-Based Structure-from-Motion
headline: VidMap: Leveraging Temporal Structure to Unlock Accurate Video-Based 3D Reconstruction
tldr: VidMap introduces a novel approach to recover camera calibration and metric poses from unconstrained videos by exploiting temporal structure, overcoming limitations of traditional SLAM. The method achieves accurate, globally consistent 3D reconstructions, enabling large-scale training data for navigation and scene understanding.
significance: By providing robust, globally consistent pose estimation from arbitrary videos, VidMap paves the way for scalable, high-fidelity datasets for autonomous navigation and scene understanding.

title: Non-Minimally Coupled Chain Inflation at High Scales
headline: Non-Minimally Coupled Chain Inflation: High-Scale Dynamics, Quantum Tunneling, and Early Universe Expansion
tldr: Chain inflation posits that the early Universe underwent a series of rapid quantum tunneling events between metastable vacua, providing an alternative to slow-roll inflation. At high energy scales, scalar fields naturally couple non‑minimally to gravity, influencing the tunneling dynamics and the resulting cosmological evolution.
significance: This framework offers a testable mechanism for generating the observed cosmic microwave background fluctuations while addressing the hierarchy of vacuum transitions in the early Universe.

title: The Fidelity and Feedback Traps: The Case for Health Digital Twins as Modular Evolving Causal Systems
headline: Health Digital Twins: Avoiding Fidelity and Feedback Traps in Modular Causal Modeling
tldr: Digital twins in healthcare can compare treatments and project patient trajectories, but copying engineering twin designs can lead to fidelity and feedback traps. The paper argues for modular, evolving causal systems that better capture the complexity of biological data.
significance: This work highlights critical pitfalls in applying mechanical digital twin frameworks to health, guiding more realistic and effective modeling strategies.

title: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research? Early evidence from two case studies
headline: Can AI Agents Automate Open-Ended AI Research? Early Case Study Evidence
tldr: This study examines whether autonomous AI agents can conduct open-ended AI research, using two case studies. It highlights the limitations of current evaluation methods and proposes a new framework for assessing agent-driven research.
significance: The findings suggest that while AI agents show promise, robust evaluation frameworks are essential for reliable progress.

title: APEX-Accounting
headline: APEX-Accounting: A New Benchmark for Evaluating AI Models on Real-World Accounting Tasks
tldr: APEX-Accounting, developed by Mercor and Ramp, tests whether large language models can perform core accounting functions such as reconciliation, expense accrual, transaction posting, and report generation. The benchmark includes 160 tasks across 10 worlds featuring diverse data formats like spreadsheets, PDFs, and more.
significance: This benchmark pushes the limits of foundation models in automating complex, real-world financial workflows, offering a rigorous standard for future AI accounting solutions.

title: The evolution of galaxy dust scaling relations in the COLIBRE simulations
headline: Tracing Dust Evolution Across Cosmic Time in COLIBRE Simulations
tldr: We map dust mass functions from z=15 to z=0 using the COLIBRE simulations, capturing dust production, growth, and destruction in a multiphase ISM. The results reveal evolving dust scaling relations that match observations and provide benchmarks for future models.
significance: These findings offer a comprehensive, self-consistent framework for dust evolution that can calibrate galaxy formation models and interpret observational data across epochs.

title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation
headline: Mitigating Prefix Failure in On-Policy Distillation with Trajectory Relays for Large Language Models
tldr: On-policy distillation uses the student’s own trajectory for supervision but suffers from prefix failure, where early mistakes lead to cascading errors. This paper introduces a trajectory-relayed approach that passes supervision only after correct prefixes, reducing misdirected continuations and saving compute.
significance: This work offers a principled solution to prefix failure in on-policy distillation, enabling more reliable and efficient training of large language models.

title: $π\mathbf{R}^2$: Reactive Real-time Flow Policies
headline: Bridging the Gap: Real-Time Reactive Flow Policies for Generalist Manipulation
tldr: Action-chunking flow policies built on large backbones run open-loop, losing reactivity. Frequent replanning could restore responsiveness, but the perception-to-action pipeline is too slow, limiting real-time performance.
significance: This work highlights the trade-off between computational efficiency and reactivity in large-scale manipulation policies, pointing toward faster perception pipelines.

title: Proportional Fairness for Harmful Decisions
headline: Revisiting Core Concepts for Allocating Public Bads: Proportional Fairness Approach
tldr: We analyze the allocation of public bads and show that traditional core definitions fail. We propose new formal criteria for proportional fairness in this context.
significance: This work reshapes fairness criteria for public bad allocation, guiding policy design.

title: Spend Experts Where You Are Unsure: Confidence-Adaptive Routing for Mixture-of-Experts LoRA
headline: Confidence-Adaptive Routing Boosts Mixture-of-Experts LoRA Efficiency
tldr: Mixture-of-Experts LoRA traditionally routes each token to a fixed number of experts, which can waste capacity on easy tokens and under-serve hard ones. By interpreting the router’s output distribution as a per-token uncertainty signal, the authors propose a confidence-adaptive routing scheme that dynamically adjusts the number of experts per token, improving efficiency and performance.
significance: This approach optimizes resource allocation in large language models, reducing computational cost while maintaining or improving accuracy.

title: QuickGWecc: Fast Bayesian pipeline for searching eccentric binaries in pulsar timing array data
headline: Fast Bayesian Pipeline Uncovers Eccentric SMBH Binaries in Pulsar Timing Data
tldr: QuickGWecc introduces a rapid Bayesian framework for detecting eccentric supermassive black hole binaries in pulsar timing array data. It significantly reduces computational cost while maintaining sensitivity, paving the way for timely identification of continuous gravitational waves.
significance: This method accelerates the search for individual gravitational wave sources, enabling quicker multimessenger follow-up.

title: S2A2: Audio-Visual Imitation Learning for Manipulation Tasks Using Acoustic Spatial Information
headline: Robots Learn to Manipulate Using Sound: Acoustic Imitation for Object Localization
tldr: This paper introduces acoustic-aware manipulation tasks where robots use auditory cues to locate and manipulate objects, requiring sound source localization and active exploration. It demonstrates that integrating acoustic spatial information improves imitation learning for manipulation.
significance: It shows that auditory cues can be leveraged for real-time robotic manipulation, expanding the sensory modalities for imitation learning.

title: Photonuclear Neutron Production in OpenMC: Verification Against MCNPX, FLUKA, and a First-Collision Analytical Solution
headline: Verifying Photonuclear Neutron Production in OpenMC with MCNPX, FLUKA, and Analytics
tldr: OpenMC’s photonuclear module was benchmarked against MCNPX, FLUKA, and an analytical model. The results confirm its accuracy for high-energy photon-induced neutron production.
significance: This validation establishes OpenMC as a reliable tool for simulating photonuclear reactions in diverse high-energy applications.

title: Re-thinking Mammography Transfer Learning: The Dataset-Informed Transfer Learning (DITL) Framework for Breast Cancer Screening and Lesion Diagnosis
headline: Dataset-Informed Transfer Learning Boosts Mammography Classification Accuracy
tldr: The DITL framework tailors transfer learning to the specific characteristics of each mammography dataset, outperforming conventional methods. It demonstrates improved diagnostic performance on both small curated sets and large clinical cohorts.
significance: This approach addresses a key limitation in medical imaging AI by enabling scalable, dataset-aware transfer learning, potentially improving breast cancer screening outcomes.

title: VetClaw: An Edge-Cloud Multimodal Agentic System for Veterinary Disease Screening
headline: VetClaw: Edge-Cloud Multimodal System for Rapid Veterinary Disease Screening Using Vision-Language Models
tldr: VetClaw combines an edge camera and a cloud-hosted vision‑language model to perform zero‑shot disease classification from images and optional text. The system decouples agent interaction from workflow orchestration, enabling real‑time veterinary screening in remote settings.
significance: VetClaw demonstrates how multimodal foundation models can be deployed in edge‑cloud pipelines to provide timely, accurate disease screening for veterinary practitioners worldwide.

title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
headline: A Structured Data Pyramid for Training Embodied Manipulation Agents Across Domains
tldr: The paper proposes a five-layer data pyramid that integrates real, simulated, synthetic, annotated, and multimodal sources to bridge the observation-action gap in embodied manipulation. It demonstrates how combining these layers can scale training of foundation models for physical interaction tasks.
significance: This framework unifies diverse data modalities, enabling scalable training of embodied agents and accelerating progress in robotics and AI.
